verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a self-hosted deployment option, but it explicitly only covers the data-storage layer — the UI, authentication, and platform updates remain managed by Braintrust rather than the user, so it's a hybrid model rather than fully self-hosting the core product. Missing for 10: evidence of self-hosting the full application/control plane (UI, auth, orchestration) not just the data store, and independent confirmation of successful full self-host deployments.
